title: BFAR distributes 100,000 tilapia fry in Ilocos

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur— The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) Ilocos distributed 100,000 tilapia fry to fisherfolk across the region during the 70th Fishery Industry Forum held Wednesday (Sept. 16) at the Dingras Civic Center in Dingras, Ilocos Norte. The distribution was part of the forum’s efforts to boost fish production and provide fisherfolk with support to improve their livelihoods. The forum, themed “Masaganang Pangisdaan, Tungo sa Maunlad na Ekonomiya,” brought together fisherfolk, fishery stakeholders, aquapreneurs and representatives from various local governments.
